"""Compare all fixed V159 endpoints with retained V156 detail and V157 coarse."""

from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

root=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic/.cache/quality-20261107/V159-regional-dc-transition-v1')
v158=Path(read(root/'plan-v1.json')['previous']);v157=Path(read(v158/'plan-v1.json')['previous'])
current=read(root/'scores-v1.json');prior=read(v157/'scores-v1.json')
cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'];old_cases=read(v157/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
assert len(cases)==len(old_cases)==822
assert all(a['id']==b['id'] and a['arrays']==b['arrays'] and a['parent']==b['parent'] for a,b in zip(cases,old_cases,strict=True))
now={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in current['rows']};old={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in prior['rows']}
for c in cases:assert now[c['id'],'parent']==old[c['id'],'parent']
groups=[];summary=[]
for version,arm in [('V156','local-control'),('V157','spatial-rgb')]:
    for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
        method=f'smooth-dc-{endpoint}-step1000';baseline=f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000'
        for condition in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']:
            for kind,cohort,fields,count in [('mixed-quiet',None,['quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16'],16),
                ('flat','fresh-flat512',['full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16'],24)]:
                selected=[c for c in cases if c['kind']==kind and c.get('cohort')==cohort and c['noise']['name']==condition]
                assert len(selected)==count
                for field in fields:
                    pairs=[{'id':c['id'],'candidate':now[c['id'],method][field],'baseline':old[c['id'],baseline][field],
                        'difference':now[c['id'],method][field]-old[c['id'],baseline][field]} for c in selected]
                    delta=[p['difference'] for p in pairs]
                    groups.append({'retained_version':version,'method':method,'baseline':baseline,
                        'kind':kind,'condition':condition,'cohort':cohort,'field':field,'cases':count,'pairs':pairs,
                        'better':sum(v<0 for v in delta),'worse':sum(v>0 for v in delta),'equal':sum(v==0 for v in delta),
                        'maximum_increase':max(delta),'maximum_decrease':min(delta)})
        for kind,condition,cohort,field in [('mesh',True,None,'template_gain'),
            ('mixed-quiet','iso6400-prior',None,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),('mixed-quiet','iso12800-prior',None,'quiet_error_RMS_DN16'),
            ('flat','iso6400-prior','fresh-flat512','full_error_RMS_DN16'),('flat','iso12800-prior','fresh-flat512','block32_RMS_DN16')]:
            key=(kind,condition,cohort)
            a=next(v[field] for v in current['summary'] if (v['kind'],v['condition'],v['cohort'])==key and v['method']==method)
            b=next(v[field] for v in prior['summary'] if (v['kind'],v['condition'],v['cohort'])==key and v['method']==baseline)
            summary.append({'retained_version':version,'method':method,'baseline':baseline,'kind':kind,'condition':condition,
                'cohort':cohort,'field':field,'candidate':a,'baseline_value':b,'percent_change':100*(a/b-1)})
assert len(groups)==40 and sum(g['cases'] for g in groups)==768 and len(summary)==20
dest=root/'retained-V156-V157-comparison-v1.json';assert not dest.exists()
save(dest,{'status':'completed-retained-V156-V157-comparison','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'retained_scores':ref(v157/'scores-v1.json'),'same822_input_parent_bindings':True,'same_parent_metric_rows':True,
    'groups':groups,'summary':summary,'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'V156 quieter learned-detail and V157 stronger standalone-coarse controls retained from exact V157 trial. Same822 inputs/parents and parent metrics verified. V156 comparison also changes architecture plus DC supervision;V157 changes DC supervision. Only current V158 sharp control isolates hinge transition. Four CFA placements/reused recipes are related,not independent scenes or significance.'})
for row in summary:print(row)
